name: Extinction
summary: Extinction is the third paid Expansion Pack for ARK: Survival Evolved.
features: Three proto-Arks which house three biomes: Desert, Snow and Forest.
Eclipses that temporarily dim the light. ( exclusive)
Electromagnetic storms that temporarily turn the sky, clouds and fog red. ( exclusive)
Geysers that launch survivors and Creatures into the air.
Meteor showers where meteors rain down upon the land and destroy structures and kill Creatures.

Orbital Supply Drops that fall from the sky and Element Node that rise from the ground that, when activated, start PvE horde-styled events. The orbital supply drops are also attacked by the corrupted dinosaurs
asa_changes: Brand new Creatures including the community voted Dreadnoughtus and the Bob's Tall Tales Armadoggo Companion.
The King Titan will now spawn in the Wastes as a World Boss that survivors can fight off for rewards.
Heavily Overhauled areas including the Tek City (which also has a barrier effect during Meteor Storms).
Brand New Areas including 2 brand new Outposts in the Snow Dome.
